name: 左側方形圖片＋右側直列文字項目
desc: 左側一張方形圖片，右側多個文字項目由上往下排列，每項有標題、說明文字和帶箭頭圖示的文字連結。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。左右兩欄，兩欄之間留明顯的空白：左側約佔四成，放一張方形圖片；右側約佔三分之一，放多個項目由上往下排成直列，整欄相對圖片垂直置中。每個項目無外框，靠左對齊：標題（可多行），下方是說明文字，最下方可放一個文字連結，連結右側附一個小圓形箭頭圖示，連結下方有一條約與連結同寬的短分隔線，沒有時省略。項目之間沒有分隔線。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：圖片在上，置中、略窄於頁面內容寬度；下方各項目依序直向排列，靠左對齊，項目內部結構不變。

en.name: Square image on the left + list of text items on the right
en.desc: A square image on the left and multiple text items stacked top to bottom on the right, each with a title, a description and a text link with an arrow icon.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Two columns with a clear gap between them: the left column takes about forty percent and holds a single square image; the right column takes about a third and holds multiple items arranged top to bottom as a list of rows, with the whole column vertically centered against the image. Each item has no frame and is aligned left: a title (may wrap to multiple lines), a description below it, and optionally a text link at the bottom with a small circular arrow icon to its right and a short divider about as wide as the link below it; omit it when there is no content. There are no dividers between the items.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The layout becomes a vertical stack: the image on top, centered and slightly narrower than the page content width; below it the items follow one after another, aligned left, with their internal structure unchanged.
